description: Adds an item to a shopping or to-do list in the family's Plannie. Get listId from get_lists. The item is added at the end of the list. Optionally give it a deadline: with a time of day, the people it's assigned to get a reminder at that moment.

dueDate.description: Deadline, ISO 8601 with offset in the household timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T17:30:00+01:00. For a day with no time, use local midnight.

hasTime.description: Whether dueDate carries a time of day. Defaults to true unless the time is local midnight.

name: add_list_item
title: Add list item
